criteria.criterion: Apple uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries
required_elements: the cobalt is in all Apple-designed batteries
criteria.promise_scope: Apple promised that by its 2025 goals it would use 100 percent recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries; beneficiaries/location are unspecified, and the benefit is a company-wide materials standard for batteries Apple designs.
criteria.observed_scope: Apple reports company-wide use of 100 percent recycled cobalt in all batteries it designs; beneficiaries and location are unspecified.
criteria.timing_requirement: The original undertaking is part of Apple's '2025 goals' and thus required achievement by 2025.
criteria.explanation: The original undertaking was a company-wide 2025 materials goal: Apple would use 100 percent recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries. Apple later reported that it "now uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all the batteries it designs," and separately that "all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt," which matches the promised action and scope. Timing is also supported because Apple said in 2026 that it "reached several targets for recycled content in select components last year," and the same 2026 release identifies the cobalt target as one of those reached targets, supporting achievement in 2025. The sources do not specify a location or beneficiary population beyond Apple's company-wide battery-design scope, and none was specified in the original promise.

delivery_support.quote: As part of this work, Apple now uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all the batteries it designs and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets.
Today, all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt, and all magnets are made with 100 percent recycled rare earth elements.
Apple also reached several targets for recycled content in select components last year.

criteria.fulfilled_part: Apple reports that it uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all batteries it designs.
